title: Research artefacts for "The Cost of Scaling Determinism: Coverage, Regression Risk and Attack Surface in a Versioned Symbolic Control Plane for LLM-Assisted Contract Analysis"
description:
Research artefacts for a longitudinal study of a deterministic, versioned contract-analysis rule engine across ten historical releases (25 to 189 rules). The study measures, on a frozen, hash-verified corpus of 618 contracts (SEC exhibits from the Material Contracts Corpus, plus the CUAD and ContractNLI test sets): - reproducibility; - coverage and precision; - regressions; - version governance; - lexical attack surface; - bounded rule adaptation.

It also compares the engine with reproduction-validated neural comparators (three CUAD models and ContractNLI Span NLI BERT).

Contents: - corpus and release manifests (SHA-256 of every document text, commit and ruleset/engine-code hashes of every engine state); - the frozen category-to-rule mapping; - per-document engine outputs and output fingerprints for every run; - per-unit evaluation files; - injection cases with benign controls; - comparator code and Step A/B/C outputs with run logs; - statistics and analysis scripts; - figures.

`verify.py` (Python standard library only) checks every file against `SHA256SUMS` and recomputes the paper's Tables 3, 5 and 6. `README.md` explains how to verify the remaining results and how to rebuild the document texts from their public sources by hash.

The engine source code is proprietary and not included; its executable releases are identified by the published hashes.

Mixed-license archive: the Zenodo record-level CC BY 4.0 designation applies only to original research data and documentation for which the authors hold rights. Original Python and shell code is MIT. MCC-derived contract excerpts in outputs remain subject to source CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 conditions. Third-party datasets, quotations, model outputs and other upstream material are not relicensed by the record-level license. See LICENSE and RELEASE_DISCLOSURE_AUDIT.md for file-level restrictions. Redistribution clearance of every embedded excerpt is not established by checksum verification.

Note on version 1.0: the DeBERTa-v2-xlarge Step B run on the 516 documents without expert labels was still in progress. It enters no reported metric. If completed and cleared for release, a later version may add it.
